summary:
REAL FIX: "no real-time data access" bug fixed in app/ai/agent.py

ROOT CAUSE FOUND:
_call_llm() mein tools SIRF PRIMARY model (openai/gpt-oss-120b) ko diye ja rahe the.
Jab primary model rate-limit hota hai (jo already ho raha tha - 200K TPD limit),
request FALLBACK_MODEL (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) ya FAST_MODEL (llama-3.1-8b-instant)
pe chali jaati thi — bina tools ke. Fallback model ke paas get_stock_price/get_company_news/
get_market_overview jaise koi tool hi nahi hota tha, isliye wo khud LLM knowledge se
jawab deta tha aur sach bolta tha "mujhe real-time data ka access nahi hai" —
jabki Finnhub/Yahoo/web-search services piche perfectly kaam kar rahe the.

FIX APPLIED (app/ai/agent.py, _call_llm function):
- Tools ab TEENO models (primary, fallback, fast) ko diye jaate hain
- Groq ke teeno models tool-calling support karte hain, safe hai
- Extra: agar koi model tools ke saath fail ho (non-rate-limit error) to
  ab bhi next model try hota hai instead of crashing (better resilience)
- Baaki sab kuch (rate limit cascade, token limits, classify_query,
  tool dispatcher, sab existing features) waisa hi rakha gaya hai - koi
  behavior change nahi kiya gaya inme

Config verified: FINNHUB_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY sab required/optional
settings sahi hain config.py mein.

[2026-08-09 08:29 UTC] Telegram bot crash fixes applied — 8 bugs fixed across 5 files:

CRASH CAUSES IDENTIFIED & FIXED:

1. BOT MODULE-LEVEL INIT CRASH (telegram_handler.py, alerts.py, jobs.py)
   - Problem: `bot = Bot(token=settings.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN)` at module level
   - If .env token missing or invalid → ImportError → whole app crashes
   - Fix: Lazy init with get_bot() singleton in handler, lazy inside jobs/alerts

2. WEBHOOK RETURNING 500 (routes.py)
   - Problem: Unhandled exceptions → FastAPI auto-returns 500 to Telegram
   - 500 = Telegram keeps retrying same update for 24hr, blocking new messages
   - Fix: try/except around JSON parse AND handle_update, always return 200

3. MARKDOWN PARSE CRASH — SILENT MESSAGE LOSS (telegram_handler.py)
   - Problem: parse_mode="Markdown" fails on unescaped chars (*_`), message lost
   - Fix: Auto-retry as plain text on TelegramError with 'parse'/'entity'/'offset'

4. TYPING TASK LEAK (telegram_handler.py)
   - Problem: Complex stop_event/cancel logic in each handler = easy to miss
   - Fix: Centralized _run_with_typing() helper — one place, always cleaned up

5. EMPTY TEXT CRASH (telegram_handler.py)
   - Problem: message.text can be whitespace-only → route_text_message("") crash
   - Fix: text.strip() guard before routing

6. MESSAGE SPLIT ON MID-WORD (telegram_handler.py)
   - Problem: chunks = [text[i:i+4096] ...] cuts mid-word, breaks Markdown
   - Fix: _safe_split() splits on newlines, hard-cuts only when single line > 4096

7. FILE_SIZE NONE CRASH (telegram_handler.py)
   - Problem: doc.file_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES → TypeError if file_size is None
   - Fix: file_size = doc.file_size or 0

8. STARTUP NON-FATAL ERRORS (main.py)
   - Problem: DB/webhook/scheduler init crash → app exits, bot goes offline
   - Fix: Each startup step in try/except — app starts even if one fails

FILES CHANGED:
- app/bot/telegram_handler.py — Rewrote with lazy bot, _run_with_typing, _safe_split
- app/api/routes.py — Always 200, JSON parse error handled
- app/main.py — All startup steps non-fatal
- app/scheduler/alerts.py — Lazy Bot() inside function
- app/scheduler/jobs.py — Lazy Bot() + all imports inside dispatcher function

[2026-08-09 08:43 UTC] Live log analysis done. 2 new issues found and fixed:

ISSUE 1 — Groq Embeddings 404 (memory.py)
- Root cause: Groq API does NOT have /embeddings endpoint
- Error: POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/embeddings → 404 Not Found
- Fix: get_embedding() now checks for OPENAI_API_KEY (optional)
  - If not set → returns None silently, BM25 handles all retrieval
  - If set → uses OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (cheap, 1536-dim)
  - BM25 (PostgreSQL FTS) works perfectly alone — no embeddings needed

ISSUE 2 — Groq Rate Limit 429 (agent.py) — MAIN CRASH REASON
- Error: openai/gpt-oss-120b — 200K TPD limit, used 199891
- Tokens were being wasted on: long system prompt, 10 history turns,
  4500-char doc context, 250-char memory snippets, large max_tokens
- Fixes applied:
  a) System prompt shortened by ~500 tokens (prompts.py)
  b) Max tokens reduced: factual 512→300, analytical 1800→1200, etc.
  c) History turns: 10→6 (saves ~400 tokens per request)
  d) Doc context truncated: 4500→3500 chars
  e) Memory snippets: 250→200 chars
  f) RateLimitError caught in agent.py → friendly message to user
     "⏳ Abhi bahut zyada requests — X minutes mein dobara try karein"
     Instead of crashing silently

ESTIMATED TOKEN SAVINGS: ~800-1000 tokens per conversation turn
(previously ~1500-2000 tokens, now ~700-1000 tokens)
This doubles the daily message capacity on free tier.

FILES CHANGED:
- app/ai/memory.py — Groq embed removed, OpenAI optional, BM25 primary
- app/ai/prompts.py — System prompt shortened ~500 tokens
- app/ai/agent.py — Token limits reduced, RateLimitError handled gracefully

[2026-08-09 08:52 UTC] 3-model cascade added for rate limit resilience.

  Primary:  openai/gpt-oss-120b  (best, 200K TPD)
  Fallback: llama-3.3-70b-versatile (good quality, SEPARATE 200K TPD pool)

Reranker chain:

Changes:

- app/ai/reranker.py: _reranker_call() also has fallback
